SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PO_REQ_NO , GD_CD_MRO FROM MRO_PO_REQ WHERE MRO_SEND = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HANL' AS BUYER , 'PO' AS DOC_TYPE , PO_REQ_NO AS KEY_NO , GD_CD_MRO AS KEP_SEQ , GD_CD AS DATA01 , REQ_QTY AS DATA02 , REQ_DATE AS DATA03 , OK_QTY AS DATA04 , APPSTATUS AS DATA05
FROM MRO_PO_REQ WHERE PO_REQ_NO = '$G_RS.PO_REQ_NO$' AND GD_CD_MRO = '$G_RS.GD_CD_MRO$'
UPDATE MRO_SEND = 'Y' MRO_SEND_DT = SYSDATE FROM MRO_PO_REQ WHERE PO_REQ_NO = '$G_RS.PO_REQ_NO$' AND GD_CD_MRO = '$G_RS.GD_CD_MRO$'
UPDATE MRO_SEND = 'E' MRO_SEND_DT = SYSDATE FROM MRO_PO_REQ WHERE PO_REQ_NO = '$G_RS.PO_REQ_NO$' AND GD_CD_MRO = '$G_RS.GD_CD_MRO$'
